_comment: The player's request for a gate jump (M7-T28, M8-T18 D84): how close to the gate's mouth the ship must be to ask, and the answer shown when it is not (the HUD upper-cases it after the gate's name: JUMPGATE: OUT OF RANGE). The reach grows with the closing speed: range_m, plus the distance flown during the hold_s hold of X, plus what the autopilot needs to slow to its run-in at the ship's braking (decel_mps2 when the ship's is not known), never more than range_cap_m (the 10 km the gate is offered from).
